article.headline: Daeshun Ruffin, Jayme Mitchell Jr. lift Jackson State over Florida A&M 66-65
article.description: — Daeshun Ruffin had 30 points and Jayme Mitchell Jr. hit a go-ahead 3-pointer with 1:11 remaining to rally Jackson State to a 66-65 victory over Florida A&M on Monday night.
article.linkText: Daeshun Ruffin, Jayme Mitchell Jr. lift Jackson State over Florida A&M 66-65

keywords: Jackson State Tigers @ Florida A&M Rattlers
article.story: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. -- — Daeshun Ruffin had 30 points and Jayme Mitchell Jr. hit a go-ahead 3-pointer with 1:11 remaining to rally Jackson State to a 66-65 victory over Florida A&M on Monday night. Ruffin also had six assists for the Tigers (6-14, 5-2 Southwestern Athletic Conference) and Mitchell added nine rebounds and three steals. His go-ahead shot was the final points of the game. Kaleb Washington finished with 17 points for the Rattlers (8-10, 5-2), who had a five-game win streak end. Jordan Chatman added 16 points and Miles Ndalama scored 10. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
